title: Solana first
blurb: Solana is where agent micropayments are growing fastest: sub-second finality, sub-cent fees, native USDC. Facilitators, kits, and payment tooling built for or running on Solana.

title: Payment protocols and standards
blurb: Open specifications that define how agents and services negotiate and settle payments: x402, MPP, L402, A2A, ERC-8004, and friends.

title: Agentic commerce and card networks
blurb: Checkout, mandates, and tokenized card credentials that let agents buy goods and services from merchants on a user's behalf.

title: Facilitators
blurb: Services that verify and settle x402 payments so sellers do not have to run chain infrastructure themselves.

title: SDKs, middleware, and toolkits
blurb: Libraries and frameworks for charging or paying over HTTP 402 and for wiring payment tools into agent stacks.

title: Agent wallets and spend controls
blurb: Wallets, key custody, and policy layers that let an agent hold funds and spend them within limits.

title: Directories and marketplaces
blurb: Explorers, bazaars, and catalogs where agents and developers discover paid APIs and services.

title: Identity, trust, and receipts
blurb: Agent identity, reputation, verifiable receipts, refunds, and monitoring for paid agent traffic.

title: Lightning and Bitcoin rails
blurb: Agent payments over the Lightning Network, including L402 tooling and wallet connections.
